name: Whispers of the Broken Dice
source:
“What if the world you woke up in wasn’t your own?”

Step into a story where every choice matters, and trust is the most dangerous gamble.

Whispers of the Broken Dice is a choice-driven visual novel with a deep narrative and stunning anime-style art. Explore a world based on DnD filled with adventure, mystery, relationships, and life-or-death decisions.
Your actions will shape not only your future—but the fate of everyone you meet.

[From [url=https://seraphgames.itch.io/whispers-of-the-broken-dice]Itch.io[/url]]
